value.rationale: This extends a recent general component theorem into a natural exceptional stratum for arbitrary r>=3. The condition p not dividing the sum is exactly what prevents residue collision while allowing the two residues to have ratio in the prime field. It clarifies a genuine boundary in the geometry of logarithmic components, not merely a numerical recomputation.
